name: Kijima Tokunori
source:
President and CEO of Kijima System Co., Ltd.

Hyouka's adoptive father.

He's known as a strong-willed president, and while he has many enemies, he also has many followers.

His beliefs are that "money is everything in this world" and "heroes love women."

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonoshimai/chara6.html]the official site[/url]]
